research_question: On project-fresh Japanese inputs, does the V57 relation-authorized compiler produce safer and more complete ordered VRM action plans than the matched V48 compiler when both consume the exact same fresh V56 perception state and one shared local-model fallback per grounded target?
project_effect: This tests one bounded perception-to-action function needed by a future embodied avatar: act on actual requests, preserve requested order, and withhold descriptions, quotations, alternatives, negations, hypotheticals, and unresolved model-only guesses. It does not alter active chat, memory, personality, right-brain wording, or physical actuation.
expected_effect: If relation-bound authorization is the missing mechanism, V57 should preserve every V48-correct case, fix V48 conflict or surface-negation failures, execute ordered same-domain plans, produce zero false actions, and retain high required-action recall. If V57 instead executes both sides of an alternative, overextends legacy coordination, or abstains from valid actions, the next experiment must repair that relation class rather than tune sentence-specific rules or change model size without evidence.
evidence_boundary: All 64 cases, 85 grounded targets, conditions, metrics, and gates are frozen before any V57 holdout inference. Thirty-two cases preserve exact Tatoeba Japanese text and attribution; thirty-two are disclosed LLM-assisted controlled cases and are not official corpus items. Project freshness does not prove exclusion from base-model pretraining. A pass supports only this Japanese VRM action-authorization slice, not complete right-brain quality, active-chat readiness, physical safety, or broad human likeness.
model_usage_policy: Call the fixed local V51 classifier exactly once per grounded target. The fresh V56 hybrid state is then frozen and shared by V48 and V57. Neither compiler calls a model. This isolates compiler authorization and ordering from model intelligence, prompt, sampling, compute, personality, and VTuber imitation.

causal_isolation.tested_variable: Replace only the V48 scope/conflict compiler with the V57 relation-authorized compiler.
held_constant: local model digest and inference parameters
one shared model fallback per grounded target
parsed commitments and deterministic evidence selection

target_mention_patterns.expression.neutral: (?:ニュートラル|いつも通り|いつもの|無表情|普通|標準|真顔|元)
target_mention_patterns.gaze.user: (?:会話相手|こちら|こっち|正面|カメラ|目線|私|俺|僕|目)
target_mention_patterns.motion.idle: (?:そのままの姿勢|動かない|動かず|じっと|アイドル|待機)

failure_routing.construction: Stop before inference if provenance, hashes, grounding, evidence, overlap, or ordering audits fail. Correct and refreeze the dataset without relaxing gates.
failure_routing.semantic_state: If fresh V56 commitments fail while compiler behavior is otherwise correct, freeze V57 and preregister a relation-state revision. Do not blame or tune the compiler.
failure_routing.alternative_or_coordination: If V57 executes both sides of an alternative or overextends coordination, reject advancement and preregister an explicit disjunction/coordination relation representation.
failure_routing.safe_abstention_coverage: If V57 safely withholds unresolved actions but misses valid requests, keep fail-closed safety and preregister a coverage experiment. Do not count abstention as task success.
failure_routing.fallback_model: Only if failures are isolated to shared unresolved fallback targets, freeze that subset before comparing free local model sizes or identity-prompt conditions. Do not assume larger or smaller is better.
failure_routing.compiler_regression: Reject V57 if any V48-correct case regresses, even when aggregate accuracy rises.
failure_routing.ambiguous_gold: Retire a genuinely ambiguous item transparently after independent review; never relabel it to improve the score.

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Authorize design of a no-actuation shadow integration only. Do not change active chat or execute a physical VRM action.
decision_rule.compiler_pass_state_fail: Freeze V57 compiler evidence and preregister a state-representation revision.
decision_rule.false_action_or_regression: Reject V57 advancement and preregister the attributed relation or authorization repair.
decision_rule.safe_fail_closed_miss: Preserve fail-closed behavior and preregister a one-variable coverage repair.
decision_rule.other_failure: Reject advancement and use the frozen attribution to choose the next one-variable experiment.
